title: Are the James Webb Space Telescope's mysterious Little Red Dots actually tiny black holes left over from the Big Bang era?
caption:
Are the mysterious Little Red Dots seen by the James Webb Space Telescope actually relics from the Big Bang? A new study suggests these cosmic objects might be primordial black holes, pre-dating the very first stars.

Source: Space - Are the James Webb Space Telescope's mysterious Little Red Dots actually tiny black holes left over from the Big Bang era?
